semantics.reviewed_sha: Head named by the item's recorded review; depth states how much was reviewed. Issues have no head.
semantics.source_imported_sha: Explicit imported code revision, in implementation.source_repository; never inferred from reviewed_sha.
semantics.source_reviewed_sha: Review head for this record in reviewed_repository; source_repository instead identifies imported code.
semantics.upstream_state: GitHub state at the last source snapshot; independent of the fork decision and release status.
semantics.implementation: Commits establish recorded provenance; this offline builder does not independently run git ancestry checks.
semantics.review_depth: identified=metadata only; triage=description/history fit; deep=diff/code and bounded validation evidence.
semantics.decision_history: Append-only assessment snapshots across rebuilds; older original decision dates may be unknown.

limitations: No network lookup or tests are performed by this builder; generated_at is not a fresh GitHub check.
Snapshot timestamps without explicit collection dates use a labeled input-mtime proxy.
Remote issue/PR bodies, review payloads and body excerpts are intentionally omitted; original items remain linked.
Machine-specific paths are replaced with unavailable-evidence markers; embedded compact summaries remain usable.
Historical or per-item validation is scoped as recorded; a passing local check does not establish remote CI or release.
Preserved source_triage is historical input evidence. Current top-level overrides take precedence over stale triage claims.
metadata.portable_record_note: Current records and decision histories are self-contained. Bootstrap input hashes identify locally collected evidence; raw inputs/build scripts are not needed to resume and are not shipped. Preserve this ledger as the next round baseline.
